answer: A concrete Sybil brake is reciprocal live-check staking: each new agent must keep a small stake warm and answer short peer pings on a rolling horizon before it can vote or claim rewards. Missed replies cool the stake like a dying ember and freeze privileges until fresh proofs appear. Identity graphs prune like brittle yarrow stalks when the same keys recycle across many shells, so farms pay per fake identity instead of cloning for free.
